leadStory: Rio Ngumoha and Victor Munoz were both left out of the England and Spain matchday squads for Saturday's Nations League game at Wembley under UEFA's 23-man cap, and Spain won 3-2 with Manchester City defenders Marc Guehi and Nico O'Reilly at fault for two goals, per Sky Sports, fifteen days before City visit Anfield.
note: No Track 2 request this edition. The lead is an absence (two Liverpool players not in a matchday squad) and an opponent's defensive errors in an international; neither resolves into a Liverpool still. Antigravity should take no action.
